//: The photographs, shown as a carousel on the birthday page - between the
greeting and the flower bed.
Copy this file to photos.json in the same folder and fill it in. Both
photos.json and the images themselves are gitignored: they are pictures of
her, and on a free GitHub Pages plan the repo serving this page has to be
public. Keep them out of the repo.
Unlike the poem and the songs, there is NO schedule here. Every photograph
is hers the moment she reaches the page, because the page only exists on
the day. The order is the order she sees them in, and the last one is the
last one - autoplay stops there rather than looping.
src      required, relative to this folder's parent (so 'photos/x.jpg')
caption  optional one line under the picture - where, when, or why
alt      optional description for a screen reader. Falls back to the
caption, which is usually the right thing anyway.
24 is the maximum; past that the extras are dropped and the console says
so. Resize before you copy them in - these load on a phone, on mobile
data, on a page that is already fetching audio. Around 1600px on the long
edge is plenty, and turns 4MB from a camera into about 300KB.
Mixed orientations are fine: the frame letterboxes rather than crops, so
nothing gets its head cut off.

photos.caption: the chai place, before we knew it would become the chai place
photos.alt: two cups on a steel table

photos.caption: you, entirely unbothered, on somebody's terrace
